verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.en: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.pt: Toma a conta dos filhos de Coate dentre os filhos de Levi, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais,
verses.en_web: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
verses.en_bbe: Let the sons of Kohath, from among the sons of Levi, be numbered by their families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.pt: De idade de trinta anos acima até cinquenta anos, todos os que entram em companhia, para fazer serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.en_web: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.en_bbe: All those from thirty to fifty years old who are able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.

verses.en: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
verses.pt: Este será o ofício dos filhos de Coate no tabernáculo do testemunho, no lugar santíssimo:
verses.en_web: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, the most holy things.
verses.en_bbe: And this is to be the work of the sons of Kohath in connection with the most holy things.

verses.en: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
verses.pt: Quando se houver de mudar o acampamento, virão Arão e seus filhos, e desarmarão o véu da tenda, e cobrirão com ele a arca do testemunho:
verses.en_web: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it,
verses.en_bbe: When all the people go forward, Aaron is to go in with his sons, and take down the veil of the curtain, covering the ark of witness with it;

verses.en: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.pt: E porão sobre ela a coberta de peles finas, e estenderão encima o pano todo de azul, e lhe porão suas varas.
verses.en_web: and shall put a covering of sealskin on it, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in its poles.
verses.en_bbe: And putting over it the leather cover and over that a blue cloth; and putting its rods in place.

verses.en: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
verses.pt: E sobre a mesa da proposição estenderão o pano azul, e porão sobre ela os pratos, e as colheres, e os copos, e as taças para fazer libações: e o pão contínuo estará sobre ela.
verses.en_web: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.
verses.en_bbe: And on the table of the holy bread they are to put a blue cloth, and on it all the vessels, the spoons and the basins and the cups; and the holy bread with them;

verses.en: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.pt: E estenderão sobre ela o pano de carmesim colorido, e o cobrirão com a coberta de peles finas; e lhe porão suas varas.
verses.en_web: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
verses.en_bbe: And over them they are to put a red cloth, covering it with a leather cover, and putting its rods in their places.

verses.en: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
verses.pt: E tomarão um pano azul, e cobrirão o candelabro da luminária; e suas lâmpadas, e suas tenazes, e seus apagadores, e todos os seus vasos do azeite com que se serve;
verses.en_web: “They shall take a blue cloth, and cover the lamp stand of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.
verses.en_bbe: And they are to take a blue cloth, covering with it the light-support with its lights and its instruments and its trays and all the oil vessels which are used for it:

verses.en: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
verses.pt: E o porão com todos os seus utensílios em uma coberta de peles finos, e o colocarão sobre umas armações.
verses.en_web: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.
verses.en_bbe: All these they are to put in a leather cover, and put it on the frame.

verses.en: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
verses.pt: E sobre o altar de ouro estenderão o pano azul, e lhe cobrirão com a coberta de peles finas, e lhe porão suas varas.
verses.en_web: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
verses.en_bbe: On the gold altar they are to put a blue cloth, covering it with a leather cover; and they are to put its rods in their places.

verses.en: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put them on a bar:
verses.pt: E tomarão todos os vasos do serviço, de que fazem uso no santuário, e os porão em um pano azul, e os cobrirão com uma coberta de peles finas, e os colocarão sobre umas armações.
verses.en_web: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry, with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.
verses.en_bbe: All the vessels which are used in the holy place they are to put in a blue cloth, covering them with a leather cover, and put them on the frame.

verses.en: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
verses.pt: E tirarão a cinza do altar, e estenderão sobre ele um pano de púrpura:
verses.en_web: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.
verses.en_bbe: And they are to take away the burned waste from the altar, and put a purple cloth on it;

verses.en: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers skins, and put to the staves of it.
verses.pt: E porão sobre ele todos os seus instrumentos de que se serve: as pás, os garfos, os braseiros, e as taças, todos os utensílios do altar; e estenderão sobre ele o propiciatório de peles finas, e lhe porão também as varas.
verses.en_web: They shall put on it all its vessels, with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins; all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.
verses.en_bbe: Placing on the cloth all its vessels, the fire-baskets, the meat-hooks, the spades, and the basins; all the vessels of the altar; they are to put a leather cover over all these, and put its rods in their places.

verses.en: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.pt: E em acabando Arão e seus filhos de cobrir o santuário e todos os vasos do santuário, quando o acampamento se houver de mudar, virão depois disso os filhos de Coate para conduzir: mas não tocarão coisa santa, que morrerão. Estas serão as cargas dos filhos de Coate no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.en_web: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.en_bbe: And after the holy place and all its vessels have been covered up by Aaron and his sons, when the tents of the people go forward, the sons of Kohath are to come and take it up; but the holy things may not be touched by them for fear of death.

verses.en: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
verses.pt: Porém ao cargo de Eleazar, filho de Arão o sacerdote, estará o azeite da luminária, e o incenso aromático, e a oferta de cereais contínua, e o azeite da unção; o cargo de todo o tabernáculo, e de tudo o que está nele, no santuário, e em seus utensílios.
verses.en_web: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”
verses.en_bbe: And Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, is to be responsible for the oil for the light, and the sweet perfumes for burning, and the regular meal offering, and the holy oil; the House and the holy place and everything in it will be in his care.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.en: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
verses.pt: Não cortareis a tribo das famílias de Coate dentre os levitas;
verses.en_web: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
verses.en_bbe: Do not let the family of the Kohathites be cut off from among the Levites;

verses.en: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
verses.pt: Mas isto fareis com eles, para que vivam, e não morram quando achegarem ao lugar santíssimo: Arão e seus filhos virão e os porão a cada um em seu ofício, e em seu cargo.
verses.en_web: but thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them everyone to his service and to his burden;
verses.en_bbe: But do this to them, so that life and not death may be theirs when they come near the most holy things; let Aaron and his sons go in and give to every one his work and that which he is to take up;

verses.en: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
verses.pt: Não entrarão para ver, quando cobrirem as coisas santas; que morrerão.
verses.en_web: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
verses.en_bbe: But they themselves are not to go in to see the holy place, even for a minute, for fear of death.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
verses.pt: Toma também a conta dos filhos de Gérson pelas casas de seus pais, por suas famílias.
verses.en_web: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;
verses.en_bbe: Let the sons of Gershon be numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.pt: De idade de trinta anos acima até cinquenta anos os contarás; todos os que entram em companhia, para fazer serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.en_web: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old; all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.en_bbe: All those from thirty to fifty years old who are able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.

verses.en: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
verses.pt: Este será o ofício das famílias de Gérson, para ministrar e para levar:
verses.en_web: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
verses.en_bbe: This is to be the work of the Gershonites, the things they are to do and take up.

verses.en: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.pt: Levarão as cortinas do tabernáculo, e o tabernáculo do testemunho, sua coberta, e a coberta de peles finas que está sobre ele encima, e a cortina da porta do tabernáculo do testemunho,
verses.en_web: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above on it, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
verses.en_bbe: They are to take up the curtains of the House, and the Tent of meeting with its cover and the leather cover over it, and the hangings for the door of the Tent of meeting;

verses.en: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
verses.pt: E as cortinas do átrio, e a cortina da porta do átrio, que está próxima do tabernáculo e próxima do altar ao redor, e suas cordas, e todos os instrumentos de seu serviço, e tudo o que será feito para eles: assim servirão.
verses.en_web: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.
verses.en_bbe: And the hangings for the open space round the House and the altar, and the curtain for its doorway, with the cords and all the things used for them; whatever is necessary for these, they are to do.

verses.en: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
verses.pt: Segundo a ordem de Arão e de seus filhos será todo o ministério dos filhos de Gérson em todos os seus cargas, e em todo o seu serviço: e lhes atribuireis em responsabilidade todas as suas cargas.
verses.en_web: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
verses.en_bbe: From the mouth of Aaron and his sons the Gershonites will have word about all the things they are to do and take up; you are to give them their orders.

verses.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.pt: Este é o serviço das famílias dos filhos de Gérson no tabernáculo do testemunho: e a responsabilidade deles estará sob a mão de Itamar, filho de Arão o sacerdote.
verses.en_web: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting: and their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.en_bbe: This is the work of the family of the Gershonites in the Tent of meeting, and they will be under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.en: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
verses.pt: Contarás os filhos de Merari por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais.
verses.en_web: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Merari are to be numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.pt: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de cinquenta anos, os contarás; todos os que entram em companhia, para fazer serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.en_web: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.en_bbe: Every one from thirty to fifty years old who is able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.

verses.en: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
verses.pt: E este será o dever de seu cargo para todo seu serviço no tabernáculo do testemunho: as tábuas do tabernáculo, e suas barras, e suas colunas, e suas bases,
verses.en_web: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
verses.en_bbe: And this is their part in the work of the Tent of meeting: the transport of the boards and the rods of the Tent, with the pillars and their bases;

verses.en: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
verses.pt: E as colunas do átrio ao redor, e suas bases, e suas estacas, e suas cordas com todos os seus instrumentos, e todo seu serviço; e contareis por seus nomes todos os vasos da guarda de seu cargo.
verses.en_web: and the pillars of the court around it, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name you shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden.
verses.en_bbe: And the pillars of the open space outside it, with their bases and their nails and cords and all the instruments used, and everything which has to be done there; all the instruments for which they are responsible are to be numbered by name.

verses.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.pt: Este será o serviço das famílias dos filhos de Merari para todo seu ministério no tabernáculo do testemunho, sob a mão de Itamar, filho de Arão o sacerdote.
verses.en_web: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”
verses.en_bbe: This is the work which the sons of Merari are to do in connection with the Tent of meeting, under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.pt: Moisés, pois, e Arão, e os chefes da congregação, contaram os filhos de Coate por suas famílias, e pelas casas de seus pais,
verses.en_web: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
verses.en_bbe: So Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of the people took in hand the numbering of the sons of the Kohathites, by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.pt: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos; todos os que entram em companhia, para ministrar no tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.en_web: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.en_bbe: Numbering all those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work in the Tent of meeting;

verses.en: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.pt: E foram os contados deles por suas famílias, dois mil setecentos e cinquenta.
verses.en_web: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.
verses.en_bbe: And the number of all these was two thousand, seven hundred and fifty.

verses.en: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.pt: Estes foram os contados das famílias de Coate, todos os que ministram no tabernáculo do testemunho, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão, como o mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.
verses.en_web: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
verses.en_bbe: This is the number of those of the Kohathites who did the work in the Tent of meeting, as they were numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.

verses.en: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
verses.pt: E os contados dos filhos de Gérson, por suas famílias, e pelas casas de seus pais,
verses.en_web: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
verses.en_bbe: And those of the sons of Gershon who were numbered by families,

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.pt: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos, todos os que entram em companhia, para ministrar no tabernáculo do testemunho;
verses.en_web: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,
verses.en_bbe: All those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work in the Tent of meeting,

verses.en: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.pt: Os contados deles por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, foram dois mil seiscentos e trinta.
verses.en_web: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.
verses.en_bbe: Who were numbered by families in the order of their fathers' houses, were two thousand, six hundred and thirty.

verses.en: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.
verses.pt: Estes são os contados das famílias dos filhos de Gérson, todos os que ministram no tabernáculo do testemunho, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão por ordem do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: This is the number of the sons of Gershon who did the work in the Tent of meeting, as they were numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.

verses.en: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.pt: E os contados das famílias dos filhos de Merari, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais,
verses.en_web: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
verses.en_bbe: And those of the sons of Merari who were numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses,

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.pt: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos, todos os que entram em companhia, para ministrar no tabernáculo do testemunho;
verses.en_web: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,
verses.en_bbe: All those from thirty to fifty years old who did the work in the Tent of meeting,

verses.en: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, por suas famílias, foram três mil e duzentos.
verses.en_web: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Who were numbered by families, were three thousand, two hundred.

verses.en: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.pt: Estes foram os contados das famílias dos filhos de Merari, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão, segundo o mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.
verses.en_web: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
verses.en_bbe: This is the number of the sons of Merari, numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.

verses.en: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.pt: Todos os contados dos levitas, que Moisés e Arão e os chefes de Israel contaram por suas famílias, e pelas casas de seus pais,
verses.en_web: All those who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
verses.en_bbe: And all the Levites who were numbered by Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of the people, by families, in the order of their fathers' houses,

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.pt: Desde o de idade de trinta anos acima até o de idade de cinquenta anos, todos os que entravam para ministrar no serviço, e ter cargo de obra no tabernáculo do testemunho;
verses.en_web: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,
verses.en_bbe: Those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work of the Tent of meeting and of its transport,

verses.en: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
verses.pt: Os contados deles foram oito mil quinhentos e oitenta,
verses.en_web: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.
verses.en_bbe: Came to eight thousand, five hundred and eighty.

verses.en: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: Como o mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés foram contados, cada um segundo seu ofício, e segundo seu cargo; os quais contou ele, como lhe foi mandado.
verses.en_web: According to the commandment of Yahweh they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service, and according to his burden. Thus were they counted by him, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.en_bbe: At the order of the Lord they were numbered by Moses, every one in relation to his work and to his part in the transport; so they were numbered by Moses at the order of the Lord.
